standard_prerequisites.name: The long exact cohomology sequence and injective embeddings in Mod(O_X)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard in this chapter; used at proof lines 365-372 to represent a class in H^1(X, F) as a global section of Q = I/F
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the representation of the class used to build the extension; the pullback step is retained in the counted span.

core_obligations: Build the inverse map: given xi in H^1(X, F), choose an injection F contained in I with I injective in Mod(O_X) and set Q = I/F; the long exact cohomology sequence exhibits xi as the image of a section tilde xi of Q over X, i.e. of a map O_X -> Q (proof lines 364-372).

Form the pullback extension: pull the displayed short exact sequence 0 -> F -> I -> Q -> 0 back along tilde xi : O_X -> Q, which yields an extension 0 -> F -> E -> O_X -> 0 drawn as a map of short exact sequences (proof lines 373-387).

Identify the two constructions: the resulting extension is the inverse of the map sending an extension 0 -> F -> E -> O_X -> 0 to the image of 1 in Gamma(X, O_X) under the connecting map, the operation of forming pullbacks being the one recorded in the cited section of Homology (proof lines 364-388).
proof_roadmap: Represent the given cohomology class by a global section of Q = I/F using an injective embedding of F and the long exact sequence (proof lines 364-372).
Pull the extension 0 -> F -> I -> Q -> 0 back along that section to obtain 0 -> F -> E -> O_X -> 0 (proof lines 373-387).
Recognise the construction as the inverse of the map described in the statement (proof line 388).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts a canonical bijection between Ext^1 in the category of O_X-modules and H^1(X, F) for a sheaf of modules on a ringed space, sending an extension 0 -> F -> E -> O_X -> 0 to the image of 1 in Gamma(X, O_X) (statement lines 349-360). The proof does not check the stated map but constructs its inverse: an injective embedding F contained in I is chosen, the class is turned into a global section of Q = I/F by the long exact sequence, and that section is then used as the map along which the extension 0 -> F -> I -> Q -> 0 is pulled back (proof lines 365-387). The step that is not formal is precisely that the two directions must be compared through the same connecting map, which is why an injective replacement of F is chosen at the start. The claim is H2: short, one construction, one cited ambient theory.
